Об этом заявили Минобороны России и Генштаб ВСУ . Российские и украинские военные договорились прекратить огонь, чтобы в город, находящийся фактически на линии фронта, смогли проехать гуманитарные колонны с помощью, а желающие покинуть Алешки смогли безопасно сделать это. Оккупированные российскими войсками Алешки находятся на левом берегу Днепра возле контролируемого ВСУ Херсона на правом берегу. Loitering munitions, civilian-grade drones, civilian vehicles and derelict equipment (including aircraft) are not included in this list. All possible effort has gone into avoiding duplicate entries and discerning the status of equipment between captured or abandoned. Many of the entries listed as 'abandoned' will likely end up captured or destroyed. Similarly, some of the captured equipment might be destroyed if it can't be recovered. text: ‼️ 🇷🇺 Успехи России: продовольственная безопасность и первые позиции в мире по производству и экспорту продуктов ▪️ Сельское хозяйство — одна из ключевых отраслей экономики России, не раз заявлял президент. ▪️ За последние годы страна заметно укрепила позиции в АПК: стала одним из крупнейших мировых экспортёров зерна, достигла самообеспеченности по большинству базовых продуктов и сделала рывок в животноводстве, пищевой переработке и агротехнологиях. По итогам 2025 года экспорт продукции АПК оценивается примерно в $41,6 млрд, а сбор зерна — около 142 млн тонн с учётом новых территорий. ▪️ В растениеводстве главным достижением стали устойчивые урожаи зерна свыше 100 млн тонн в последние годы; в 2025 году собрано около 142 млн тонн — один из лучших результатов новейшей истории. Россия сохраняет лидерство по экспорту пшеницы и укрепляет позиции на мировом зерновом рынке. ▪️ В экспорте АПК произошёл особенно заметный сдвиг: за 25 лет поставки выросли примерно в 30 раз, а в 2025 году достигли около $41,6 млрд. title: Reader Q&A: After Lula’s sensational victory in Brazil’s presidential election, post your questions for the Guardian’s Latin America correspondent
text: 1h ago 20.00 EDT Welcome to the Conversation View image in fullscreen President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Photograph: Amanda Perobelli/Reuters After losing the first round of Brazil’s presidential election to far right rival Flávio Bolsonaro, incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, better known simply as Lula, pulled off the most stunning political fightback in modern Brazilian history by winning the second, in so doing securing a fourth presidential term. It will see him become the country’s longest-serving leader. The result – 51.79% to Lula, 48.21% to Bolsonaro – was delivered after a supreme court judge had extended polling time by two hours, and after Lula’s camp accused their opponents of sabotaging public transport in an attempt to keep their voters from the polls. It was the first time in Brazilian electoral history that a first-round verdict had been overturned. But Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro who is serving a 27-year jail term for his part in an attempted coup after the last presidential election, refused to accept the result – just as his father had done, four years before. title: Politics live: UN condemns Labor and Coalition blocking bill to ban shackling pregnant women; texting triple-zero trial begins
text: 20.01 EDT Tory Shepherd UN experts ‘disappointed’ after major parties block bill to ban shackling during childbirth UN experts are disappointed that bills to ban shackling during childbirth and strip-searching children were blocked by the major parties. The independent senator Lidia Thorpe introduced the bills to the Senate, where Labor and the Coalition blocked their progress . The UN human rights council special procedures experts said Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander women and children were disproportionately affected by the measures: It is disappointing that parliament was not given the opportunity to formally decide on reforms aimed at protecting the dignity, bodily integrity and rights of women and children deprived of liberty. The failure of these bills to proceed should not mark the end of efforts to address these longstanding human rights concerns. We encourage Australian authorities and parliamentarians to continue pursuing reforms. Lidia Thorpe. Photograph: Jay Kogler/EPA
author: Kat Wong

title: ‘Digital hostile environment’: AI secretly being embedded across Home Office, report claims
text: AI is being trialled in near-total secrecy, with officials routinely invoking national security to stonewall FoI requests, the report says. Photograph: Gary E Perkin/Alamy Home Office ‘Digital hostile environment’: AI secretly being embedded across Home Office, report claims Tasks from determining asylum seekers’ ages to border surveillance now involve AI, says Open Rights Group Diane Taylor Mon 26 Oct 2026 20.01 EDT Last modified on Mon 26 Oct 2026 20.03 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google AI has been embedded across the Home Office in near-total secrecy, reinforcing the so-called hostile environment for immigration, according to research. Tasks from the detection of potential sham marriages to determining the age of asylum seekers and checking through the contents of phones of new arrivals now involve use of the technology, according to a report by Open Rights Group (ORG). It is also being used to conduct surveillance of borders, through live facial recognition and AI-powered drones
author: Diane Taylor
